about.description: Open-source AI job search agent and job finder: scan job boards, score each job 1-5 against your CV before you apply, tailor an ATS-friendly resume and cover letter, get interview prep and a job application tracker. It helps you fill in each application; you press Submit. Runs locally in your AI coding CLI (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and more).

name: career-ops v1.35.0: The Wider Net
body:
<!-- co:release-notes:career-ops-v1.35.0 -->
This release widens where career-ops looks: nine new job sources, from the applicant systems of US school districts to OCC Mundial in Mexico. It carries work from 86 people, 50 of them contributing for the first time.

### Highlights

- **Nine new job sources.** AppliTrack, NEOGOV, Red Rover and SchoolSpring, used by US K-12 districts and community colleges, by @raymondwilliamskc (#4360). HiringRoom by @cRolandoJr (#4460), OCC Mundial by @VictorMeneses77 (#3748), and Eploy, PeopleSoft Candidate Gateway and PrevueAPS by @Schlaflied (#4055, #3739, #3919). BambooHR, already supported, is now part of the full scan (`scan:full`), by @ilyakanevskiy (#4365).
- **A master career profile you review fact by fact.** `node career-profile.mjs import --review` reads your CV and lets you approve, edit or skip each fact; only approved facts are saved, and `validate` checks the result. Also available as `/career-ops master-profile`. By @Kilaa13 (#4456).
- **CV details.** An optional professional title under your name by @Zoubeir23 (#3763), an optional one-line `context` for each experience entry by @lesiashu (#4049), and a guard that stops `generate-pdf` from printing work experience out of chronological order, by @abp002, who picked up @kmichels' #2343 (#4489).
- **Your data root, in more scripts.** If your data lives outside the code checkout (`CAREER_OPS_ROOT`), CV and cover letter PDFs now find it, by @shaurya20335 (#4486) and @marcosfemonteiro (#4314), and so do `set-status` by @abankar1 (#3988), `hired-share`, `reply-watch`, `paste-reply` and `batch-tailor` by @alejandra-dahl (#4571, #4570), and `fix-slugs` and `validate-portals` by @SulimanAbdulrazzaq (#4287).
- **Install and update.** `npm install` no longer fails on Linux distributions without `apt-get`, such as Fedora, by @Zoubeir23 (#4233). `npx @santifer/career-ops init` no longer fails at `npm install` on Windows, by @samintisar (#4572). `node update-system.mjs status` prints your version and commit, by @Shaamak (#3897).

### Updating

Your agent offers this update at the start of your next session. If it doesn't, run this once in your career-ops folder:

```bash
node update-system.mjs apply --confirm
```

On 1.33 or earlier the prompt may say your system files differ: say yes. Coming from 1.33 or earlier, that first update installs the current `main` rather than this release. Your CV, profile, tracker and reports are not touched, and there is nothing else to do.

If you updated from 1.33 or earlier after 1.34.0 came out, your install may report 1.34.0 while running a later snapshot of `main`. This update moves it forward to the 1.35.0 release.

New installs: `npx @santifer/career-ops init`.

### Thank you

This release carries 161 pull requests from 86 people, 50 of them contributing for the first time.
